responsibility: Declares the Darwin host PCH mapping helpers and binds them into the HOST_HOOKS_GT_PCH_GET_ADDRESS and HOST_HOOKS_GT_PCH_USE_ADDRESS macros. It is the small interface/header companion to host-darwin.cc, exposing Darwin-specific host hooks for GCC’s precompiled-header loader.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface/header half of the host-darwin pair: it declares the Darwin host PCH address helpers and binds them to HOST_HOOKS_GT_PCH_* macros, while host-darwin.cc provides the actual mmap-based implementation.
